evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies core transaction download and orphan handling logic in net_processing.cpp, txorphanage.cpp, txdownloadman_impl.cpp, and txrequest.cpp.
rationale: Resolves multiple relay liveness and stalling vulnerabilities that allow adversarial peers to pin orphans and drop honest 1p1c CPFP transactions. As noted in the description, malicious announcers can stall orphans by disconnecting during reconsideration, poison wtxid-keyed reject filters with witness-stripped transactions, or wipe orphan state across all peers on temporary feerate failures, directly impairing fee-bumping reliability and transaction propagation under adversarial conditions.
